description: Rewrite EXISTING admired Chinese/English expository prose so its reasoning is easier to follow — shrink the inferential STEP SIZE and re-anchor each step on ground the reader already holds (given-new), while KEEPING the voice, the vocabulary (never 对齐词汇), the facts/claims/stance, and staying lean (net length <= ~1.3x). Method: detect >=2-move leaps, unfold each into its minimal chain, subtract ornament. Use for "这段逻辑跳太快，放慢但别动文风/词汇", "reduce the inferential step size", "$logic-pacer". ABSTAIN if the prose is already followable. NOT de-AI (→humanizer-academic), NOT simplify-words/对齐词汇, NOT summarize/translate, NOT reorder points, NOT generate new prose.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
